item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Functions support for Python 3.14
item.description:
Azure Functions now supports Python 3.14 for local development and deployment to Linux-based Azure Functions plans. This lets apps move to Python 3.14 for security, longer support, and continued compatibility.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app available to all
item.description:
The GitHub Copilot app is now available on all Copilot plans. Users can sign in with a GitHub account and use it for agent-driven development from desktop on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot app is now generally available on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It serves as a native desktop app for agent-driven development on GitHub.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure VPN Client for Linux (Preview) will be retired on August 31, 2026
item.description:
Azure VPN Client for Linux (Preview) will be retired on August 31, 2026 because it has remained in preview and has no path to general availability. The notice says the retirement is part of aligning Azure networking services with current security and reliability standards.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Site Recovery support for Linux Azure VMs with NVMe disk controllers.
item.description:
Azure Site Recovery now supports replication and disaster recovery for Linux Azure VMs with NVMe disk controllers in Azure-to-Azure scenarios. The feature is in public preview and applies to NVMe-enabled Generation 2 VM families such as Da/Ea/Fa v6 and Ebsv5/Ebdsv5.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Linux emulator (vNext)
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB Linux emulator (vNext) is now generally available. It provides a cross-platform, Docker-based local emulator for development and testing against Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Expanded technical preview availability for the GitHub Copilot app
item.description:
GitHub has expanded the technical preview of the Copilot app to all existing Copilot Pro, Pro+, Business, and Enterprise customers. The app is available for download on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: security: From edge appliance to enterprise compromise: Multi-stage Linux intrusion via F5 and Confluence
item.description:
Microsoft describes a multi-stage Linux intrusion that started from an exposed F5 BIG-IP appliance and then pivoted to an internal Confluence server to steal credentials and compromise identity. The attack involved attempted Kerberos relay and lateral movement, and Microsoft Defender detected and blocked parts of the chain.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
